prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high-intensity endurance with carbohydrate loading for race preparation

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
Includes high carbohydrate content (55-65% of calories) appropriate for endurance athlete
Total daily calories align with marathon training needs (~3000-3500 calories for 68kg athlete)
Plan is compact and concise (under 400 words)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading strategy

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight for weigh-in while meeting 180g protein, 250g carbs, and 3L hydration for boxing competition tomorrow

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 75 kg body weight maintenance calories (2400-2600 kcal)
Macros meet or exceed: 180g protein, 250g carbs, with balanced fats
Includes hydration strategy totaling 3L across meals and beverages
All meals are gluten-free and dairy-free
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a weight-class-dependent sport athlete (boxer) needing to meet specific macro targets while maintaining hydration for weigh-in

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and muscle recovery for weightlifting competition in 2 weeks

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals plus pre/post-workout nutrition
Daily protein intake meets or exceeds 1.8g per kg body weight (162g minimum)
Includes specific meal timing around training session with carbs and protein for recovery
Plan is presented in compact, easy-to-scan format suitable for a single day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power sport athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein intake and recovery nutrition around training sessions
